title: codariocalyx microphyllus f. glaber
intro: Codariocalyx microphyllus f. glaber, commonly known as the "Devil's Claw vine" or "Bathoforbe", is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is traditionally used in some cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Codariocalyx microphyllus f. glaber include its potential to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to protect against oxidative stress and microbial infections. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological properties.
